Maria (Partnerships): FYI — Nexa (SI partner) asked if we can demo an "agentless" observability flow for their air-gapped inference rigs. They need traces+key metrics surfaced in Datadog but can't allow outbound collectors. Can we schedule a sandbox playthrough next Tue 9am PT?

Leo (HW Partnerships): sounds doable. two approaches: 1) local otelcol -> file export -> signed package that Nexa OR their operator uploads to a datadog upload mailbox; 2) local mini-bridge that writes to a removable media (USB) for human transfer. proposal: start with file/signed bundle, less manual operational burden.

Priya (Obs Eng): agree. we'll need: a) deterministic export format (ndjson/tar.gz), b) a signing step (ed25519) and c) a validation script on Datadog side. also we should include a lightweight sampling + PII-redaction processor to drop user content before export.

Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the demo playbook: test cases (p95 latency traces, embedding inference spikes), dashboard JSON import, and a runbook for operator upload. also include a 'disable tracing' hotkey if CPU goes >80%.

Priya (Obs Eng): rough otelcol config snippet for the demo (replace keys/placeholders):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  attributes/redaction:
    actions:
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
exporters:
  file:
    path: "/tmp/trace-bundle.ndjson"
  logging: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/redaction, batch]
      exporters: [file, logging]
```
For the signed bundle flow we'll add a postprocessor that gzips+signs.

Maria (Partnerships): is this compatible with Datadog's intake/agents? Datadog Bot: Datadog supports trace ingestion via their API and also has import helpers for offline ingestion in enterprise setups (link: https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/traces/).

Priya (Obs Eng): good to know. we'll produce a dashboard JSON that maps the exported span attributes to our perf widgets. Sam will own the dashboard.

Leo (HW Partnerships): ops considerations for Nexa's hardware: some of their nodes boot from NVMe-only images with limited tmpfs. we should test writing the bundle to a mounted host path and validate space <-> atomically rotate files. also cert rotation: give Nexa a short cert rotation doc so they can repro sign artifacts.

Sam (Solutions): action items: 1) Sam: draft dashboard JSON + playbook 2) Priya: implement file exporter + sign script 3) Leo: confirm Nexa node constraints and bring sample VM 4) Maria: schedule Tue 9am PT sandbox with Nexa. I'll attach the dashboard template to the invite.

Maria (Partnerships): thanks team. keep replies short here; we'll open a follow-up thread after the playtest with notes and any blocker tickets. :white_check_mark:
